    Left ideals as right ideals over the opposite algebra #

    Restriction of scalars along A ≃ (Aᵐᵒᵖ)ᵐᵒᵖ identifies the principal right ideal generated by op e with the literal principal left ideal Ae. This identification transports intrinsic biseriality between the two objects.

        Uniseriality of the principal right ideal generated by op e over the opposite algebra transports to uniseriality of the literal left ideal Ae. The scalar conversion is the canonical double-opposite identification.
